chassis_tag_watch.verdict: chassis tag did not move beyond its own at-rest scatter: the run-window max radial offset is the same order as the 39.7 mm maximum measured with the robot untouched for 40 s, and the baseline itself was formed from only 2 resolved samples so it carries most of that spread. No sustained excursion, and the 120 mm / 15 deg bound was never approached on 3 consecutive resolved samples.
chassis_tag_watch.honest_limit: this bounds GROSS chassis motion only; the tag's own error_95 is ~93 mm. Fine stillness rests on the joint telemetry, where the worst measured non-L0 joint stayed 0.439 deg from logical zero for all 1560 ticks.
